name: cotrader
description: Codex plugin for A-share, cross-market, and authorized Chrome-session research plus webpage extraction.

interface.shortDescription: A-share, cross-market, and Chrome-session research for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Cotrader packages the explicit $transaction, $contrast, and $chrome-research skills plus the fetch_and_extract_webpage MCP server. Use $transaction for A-share abnormal-move and risk analysis, $contrast for cross-market same-theme comparison, and $chrome-research to read scoped evidence from an authorized Chrome session through the separately installed chrome:control-chrome skill. It is for research support only and does not provide deterministic buy or sell advice.
defaultPrompt: $contrast 固态电池 海外同题材股票对比
$chrome-research 读取当前 Chrome 页面并提取带时间戳的研究证据
